headline: 8 contracts/addresses catalogued on Ethereum; USDat proxy and sUSDat token identified with multiple admin/operator addresses surfaced from Etherscan transaction history.

findings.text: Etherscan name-tag search for 'Saturn USDat' surfaced: USDat token proxy (0x23238f20), sUSDat token (0xd1663374), Saturn Deployer label on 0x8CBA689B. No additional name-tagged contracts found.

Protocol website https://app.saturn.credit/ was unreachable. Docs at https://saturncredit.gitbook.io/saturn-docs fetched successfully but contained no deployed addresses page. No protocol_metadata.deployed_contracts_doc could be confirmed.

No audit links provided in protocol context. A secondary source (CoinGecko article) mentions audits by Three Sigma and Certora, but no PDF URLs were discoverable in this run. Audit details recorded as unknowns.
No GitHub repo provided in protocol context. The Foundry remappings visible in USDat proxy Etherscan source code suggest a private or unlisted repo. No deployment artifacts could be walked.
Protocol is Ethereum-only per pinned context. Only Ethereum explorer searched. Zero results for other chains.
No factory contract identified. Saturn is a dual-token stablecoin wrapper with no enumerable child pools. D6 not applicable.

Role taxonomy applied: USDat proxy (token), USDat implementation (other), ProxyAdmin (proxy_admin), ProxyAdmin owner (admin/unknown actor class), whitelist admin (admin EOA calling Whitelist), operator admin (admin EOA calling EnableEarning/SetAssetCap), sUSDat vault (vault token), deployer (other).

All addresses in admin_addresses[] trace to fetched Etherscan URL for 0x23238f20 or search result snippets for 0xd1663374. sUSDat address confirmed via search result snippet from etherscan.io token page. ProxyAdmin 0xcf1072da5f0d127aef99136489bad08bfa3d1a7d confirmed from internal transaction in fetched page.

rationale.verdict: Discovery run catalogued 8 addresses on Ethereum from Etherscan transaction history and constructor arguments decoded on the USDat proxy page. Protocol website was unreachable; no GitHub repo or audit PDFs were accessible. Admin addresses include a ProxyAdmin contract, its owner EOA, a whitelist admin EOA, and an operator admin EOA — all identified from live on-chain call data. sUSDat vault address confirmed via Etherscan search snippet. Audit firms (Three Sigma, Certora) referenced in secondary sources only; no PDF URLs fetched.

protocol_metadata.about: Saturn is a dual-token stablecoin protocol on Ethereum that issues USDat, a permissioned stablecoin backed 1:1 by tokenized U.S. Treasuries (via M0's $M token), and sUSDat, an ERC-4626 yield-bearing vault that accrues dividends from STRC — Strategy's (formerly MicroStrategy) perpetual preferred equity instrument collateralized by its Bitcoin treasury. Users mint USDat by depositing USDC through whitelisted addresses, then optionally stake USDat into sUSDat to gain STRC credit yield targeting 11%+ APY. sUSDat's price appreciates as STRC dividends vest, with exit via a 3–7 day withdrawal queue or secondary market.
